minutes_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  January 10, 2023

The Alhambra Design Review Board Meeting was held on January 10, 2023. The Design Review
Board secretary Rick Abe opened the meeting at 7:30 pm. Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was
closed at 7:35 pm. Mr. Abe kept the zoom channel open and available until 8:00 pm to address any
public or potential applicants.

Note that there was an informational email sent to all applicants at 2:30 pm, January 10, 2023 (the
afternoon of the meeting), as soon as the forecasted lack of quorum was identified. Phone calls and
voicemails were also provided to all applicants as possible.

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 24th day of January, 2023.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
